entries.label: District reporting completeness threshold (1b)
entries.note: Score item 1b is the percentage of districts whose facility reporting rate is at least this value; the app starts at 90% and the Reporting Rate page can change it.

entries.label: Reporting threshold quick picks
entries.note: The values the Reporting Rate page offers as quick picks for the district reporting threshold.

entries.label: Extreme outlier bound
entries.note: A monthly value is an extreme outlier when it lies more than 5 median absolute deviations from its district's median (Hampel X84).

entries.label: Outlier baseline years
entries.note: The district median and MAD used for the outlier bounds are computed from all years except the latest, so the latest year cannot hide its own outliers.

entries.label: Adequate range for consistency ratios
entries.note: A district's consistency ratio (the ratio of its annual totals) is adequate when it is between 1 and 1.5 inclusive.

entries.label: Consistency ratios checked
entries.note: The internal consistency ratios checked for every indicator group (numerator/denominator).

entries.label: Consistency ratios added for immunization
entries.note: The consistency ratios added to the common ones when the indicator group is vaccine.

entries.label: ANC1/Penta1 expected ratio multiplier
entries.note: The expected anc1/penta1 ratio is multiplied by this factor to allow for mortality between the first antenatal visit and the first Penta dose.

entries.label: Assumed anc1 coverage for expected ratios
entries.note: When no survey coverage is supplied, calculate_ratios_summary() builds the expected ratios from an assumed anc1 coverage of 98% (the app passes the country's survey estimates instead).

entries.label: Assumed penta1 coverage for expected ratios
entries.note: When no survey coverage is supplied, calculate_ratios_summary() builds the expected ratios from an assumed penta1 coverage of 97% (the app passes the country's survey estimates instead).

entries.label: Assumed penta3 coverage for expected ratios
entries.note: When no survey coverage is supplied, calculate_ratios_summary() builds the expected ratios from an assumed penta3 coverage of 89% (the app passes the country's survey estimates instead).

entries.label: Assumed opv1 coverage for expected ratios
entries.note: When no survey coverage is supplied, calculate_ratios_summary() builds the expected ratios from an assumed opv1 coverage of 97% (the app passes the country's survey estimates instead).

entries.label: Assumed opv3 coverage for expected ratios
entries.note: When no survey coverage is supplied, calculate_ratios_summary() builds the expected ratios from an assumed opv3 coverage of 78% (the app passes the country's survey estimates instead).

entries.label: Assumed pcv1 coverage for expected ratios
entries.note: When no survey coverage is supplied, calculate_ratios_summary() builds the expected ratios from an assumed pcv1 coverage of 97% (the app passes the country's survey estimates instead).

entries.label: Assumed rota1 coverage for expected ratios
entries.note: When no survey coverage is supplied, calculate_ratios_summary() builds the expected ratios from an assumed rota1 coverage of 96% (the app passes the country's survey estimates instead).

entries.label: Overall score components (RMNCAH)
entries.note: The annual data quality score is the mean of these rows of the overall score table: reporting, completeness, outliers and the share of districts with adequate ratios.

entries.label: Overall score components (immunization)
entries.note: The annual data quality score is the mean of these rows of the overall score table: reporting, completeness, outliers and the share of districts with adequate ratios.

entries.label: Completeness adjustment factor k (default adjustment)
entries.note: adjust_service_data(adjustment = "default") uses k = 0.25 for every indicator group (anc, idelv, pnc, vacc, opd, ipd).

entries.label: Starting k in the app
entries.note: A new dataset starts with k = 0 for every indicator group, so the app adjusts nothing until the user picks a k on the Data Adjustment page.

entries.label: k values offered
entries.note: The k values the Data Adjustment page offers for each indicator group.

entries.label: Reporting rate cutoff
entries.note: Before adjusting, a reporting rate below 75% (or missing) is replaced by the district's median reporting rate.

entries.label: Reporting rates used for the replacement median
entries.note: The replacement median is taken over the district's reporting rates between 75% and 100% inclusive.

entries.label: Outliers replaced after adjustment
entries.note: After the k adjustment, values more than 5 MAD from the district's median monthly value (baseline: all years except the latest) are replaced by the median of the district's other (non-outlier) months in the same year; missing months get the district's median for that year.

entries.label: Neonatal mortality rate
entries.note: Default neonatal mortality rate (2.5%) of calculate_indicator_coverage() when no rate is supplied; the rate it is given also fills in regions the survey has no value for.

entries.label: Post-neonatal mortality rate
entries.note: Default post-neonatal mortality rate (2.4%) of calculate_indicator_coverage() when no rate is supplied; the rate it is given also fills in regions the survey has no value for.

entries.label: Stillbirth rate
entries.note: Default stillbirth rate (2%) of calculate_indicator_coverage() when no rate is supplied; the rate it is given also fills in regions the survey has no value for.

entries.label: Twin rate
entries.note: Default twin rate (1.5%) of calculate_indicator_coverage() when no rate is supplied; the rate it is given also fills in regions the survey has no value for.

entries.label: Pregnancy loss rate
entries.note: Default pregnancy loss rate (3%) of calculate_indicator_coverage() when no rate is supplied; the rate it is given also fills in regions the survey has no value for.

entries.label: ANC1 survey coverage
entries.note: Default ANC1 survey coverage (98%) of calculate_indicator_coverage() when no rate is supplied; the rate it is given also fills in regions the survey has no value for.

entries.label: Penta1 (DTP1) survey coverage
entries.note: Default Penta1 (DTP1) survey coverage (97%) of calculate_indicator_coverage() when no rate is supplied; the rate it is given also fills in regions the survey has no value for.

entries.label: Survey year
entries.note: Default survey year in calculate_indicator_coverage(); the app uses the year of the country's latest survey.

entries.label: Starting twin and pregnancy loss rates in the app
entries.note: A new dataset starts with a twin rate of 1.5% and a pregnancy loss rate of 3%; neonatal, post-neonatal and stillbirth rates come from the survey.

entries.label: Vaccine coverage target (national)
entries.note: At national level a vaccine (BCG, Penta3, measles1) reaches the target when its coverage is at least this value.

entries.label: ANC4 coverage target
entries.note: Units reach the ANC4 target when their coverage is at least this value.

entries.label: Institutional live births coverage target
entries.note: Units reach the institutional live births target when their coverage is at least this value.

entries.label: Dropout rate target
entries.note: Units meet the dropout target (Penta1-Penta3, Penta3-measles1) when their dropout rate is below this value.

entries.label: High performer threshold (other indicators)
entries.note: CacheConnection$get_high_performers() lists the units at or above this coverage for indicators without a specific target.

entries.label: Vaccine coverage target (regions and districts)
entries.note: Below national level a vaccine (BCG, Penta3, measles1) reaches the target when its coverage is at least this value.

entries.label: Very low institutional MMR
entries.note: A unit whose institutional maternal mortality ratio is below this value is flagged as very low, a sign of under-reported deaths.

entries.label: Very low institutional stillbirth rate
entries.note: A unit whose institutional stillbirth rate is below this value is flagged as very low, a sign of under-reported stillbirths.

entries.label: Completeness ratios compared
entries.note: The completeness ratios at which the institutional mortality is compared with the UN estimates.
